hooks.expectedPayoff: Identity of person who wrote letter signed with Tobias Marrow's name and their knowledge about the Margery's cargo
hooks.notes: Crane admitted he wrote the letter using Tobias's name: 'I signed your father's name because I thought the warden would come for his name and not for mine.'

hooks.expectedPayoff: What happened to the Margery and its cargo
hooks.notes: Crane revealed: 'I ferried the Margery's crew the night she sailed, and I wrote it in the ledger, and I wrote something else in it too. Your father did not steal anything. He was paid to sink the barge and he would not, and the men who paid him sank it with him aboard.'

hooks.expectedPayoff: What Absalom Crane knows about the Margery's sinking
hooks.notes: Crane revealed he ferried the Margery's crew the night it sailed and that Tobias was paid to sink the barge but refused, so the men who paid him sank it with him aboard.

hooks.expectedPayoff: What Elspeth and Jonas will discover at the abbey chapel

hooks.expectedPayoff: Whether Absalom Crane will survive to reveal what he knows about the Margery
hooks.notes: Crane died before midnight on October 4th, after revealing information about the Margery's sinking.

hooks.expectedPayoff: Retrieving the strongbox from the abbey chapel before the parish council discovers Crane's death

hooks.expectedPayoff: The identities of the men who paid to sink the Margery and are still alive, with one on the parish council
